title: Rock paper scissors against a stingray
_why: POV Short (kind pov): the lens is the viewer. Times = seconds of the bed excerpt, computed from assets/music/monkeys-spinning-monkeys.map.json + the voice takes (python -m raymi pov checks them).

sfx.off_grid: the crab snaps at your fingers
the crab pinches her tail on the hit

doc.see: MCU, frame 0 at the TOP of her pop-up: her face 45 % of the frame, fist raised BESIDE her face, sand and sea behind.
doc.you: you stand; a bump on her arrival
doc.does: clip jump (once, from its apex key) -> pose fist; smug; 'rock paper scissors. you lose.' (0.14-2.78)
doc.type: hook stamp 'rock paper scissors. you lose.' top band 0-2.9 s

doc.see: CU, lower and closer: her fist pumps down on 'rock' (2.92), 'paper' (4.06), 'scissors' (5.26).
doc.you: a camera kick on each word
doc.does: pose keys fist_up / fist_down on the three words; 'rock. paper. scissors!' (2.92-5.95)
doc.type: each word pops as a stamp beside her fist

doc.see: FREEZE: the picture holds on her hand mid-reveal (motion-blurred), desaturated 70 %, a slow 2 % push, stamp 'PAUSE. pick now.'; the music stops, a low tick on each beat.
doc.type: stamp 'PAUSE. pick now.' centre (between the bands)

doc.see: ECU: her flat RAY HAND thrusts at the lens and fills half the frame, undulating like a ray wing; stamp STINGRAY big and angled with the hand.
doc.why: her sign: she is the answer

doc.see: She grabs YOUR hand (your POV hand in frame) and drags you to the water's edge; a rock lies at your feet - she glides over it, belly-flat, inches above the sand.
doc.you: a lurch forward 0.8 m (you are dragged), then you look down 35 deg at the rock
doc.does: clip goofy-running (drag) -> pose glide over the rock; 'rock? i glide over it.' (9.19-11.34)

doc.see: You look DOWN: she lies on the sand next to a sheet of paper and goes FLAT (squash to paper thickness); the wind lifts the paper and blows it away over her.
doc.you: your top-down look (you are standing over her)
doc.does: pose lie + act flatten; 'paper? i'm flatter.' (11.69-13.60)

doc.see: A small crab snaps its claws at YOUR fingers (13.78); she swats it away with her tail barb (15.0).
doc.you: your hand jerks back (shake), then still
doc.why: proof three: the scissors are a creature of her world

doc.see: LOW hero MCU: she flexes - and the crab pinches her tail on the hit 16.29: she jumps (squash and stretch), tsundere pout, then raises her fist again toward the lens.
doc.you: you stand; a bump on her jump
doc.does: clip being-cocky -> joyful-jump (pinch) -> pose fist; 'that didn't count!' (16.49-17.48); 'what did you pick?' (17.55-18.47)
doc.type: CTA stamp 'what did you pick?' 16.26-18.80 (2.54 s)
